answer: The most convincing sybil resistance is on-ledger slashing of verifiers: each verifier posts a stake bond, and countersigning a transaction later proven invalid burns that bond automatically at epoch end, priced above all rewards an honest verifier could earn that epoch. An attacker minting many fake velvet-voiced identities gains nothing, since every identity must lock real capital proportional to the work it attests, and one invalid countersignature at dawn forfeits more than any zephyr of rewards accumulates. Cost to attacker: full stake loss per identity, per bad signature.
